title: The Case of the Burglar Who Never Slept
slogan: AI NEWS · HUMAN-CENTRED · HUMANS IN CONTROL
next: NEXT CASE · TOMORROW 7:30 AM ET · THE MISSING JUNIOR
music: Tense 1940s film-noir jazz: muted trumpet, pizzicato upright bass, brushed snare, minor key, no vocals.
ambience: Steady night rain on a window, distant city traffic, faint electrical hum, no music.

shots.say: Case nine. A burglar who never sleeps, never gets bored, and works for about fifty dollars a job.

sfx.prompt: Heavy rain against a window pane at night, close and intimate

shots.say: September twenty-fifth. One hacker types a few orders. Fewer than a hundred Chinese characters. Then lets the machines go to work.

sfx.prompt: A few quick keystrokes on a computer keyboard, then the enter key
Rising digital whirr of many small machines starting up at once, subtle

shots.say: AI agents, running on an open-source platform called Cairn, start trying doors. Shopping sites in the US, Canada, Australia and Japan. More than twelve hundred of them.

ov.sub: AI agents trying shop doors in the US, Canada, Australia, Japan

sfx.prompt: Many door handles rattling and soft knocks along a long corridor, one after another

shots.say: A typical break-in: about twenty-three hours of patient, automated probing.

sfx.prompt: Old clock ticking, speeding up into a fast whirr of turning gears

shots.say: When the front door held, the agents went round the back. A forgotten control panel. A flaw. Hours of trial and error.

ov.sub: a forgotten control panel, a flaw, hours of trial and error

sfx.prompt: Rainy back alley at night, dripping gutters, a metal door creaking open slowly
A single metal lock clicking open

shots.say: More than a hundred companies were hit. Reuters named some: John Deere and SharkNinja. Deere says there's no sign sensitive information was accessed. SharkNinja says the site held only product support, and the threat is contained.

ov.sub: named by Reuters from the hacker's own activity

sfx.prompt: Deep cinematic low drum hit with a short tail

shots.say: The researcher who found it says it's not script kiddie stuff. His estimate: about five thousand dollars in AI tokens.

sfx.prompt: Receipt printer printing a long receipt, then a tear

shots.say: The burglar got cheaper. So the basics matter more. Patch what you forgot you had. Turn on two-step login. Check your statements.

items: Patch what you forgot you had

sfx.prompt: Three pencil tick marks on paper, a few seconds apart

shots.say: The machines don't sleep. So the basics can't either. Case closed.

sfx.prompt: Rain on a city rooftop at night, distant siren far away
Single heavy rubber stamp thud on paper on a wooden desk
